title: Grateful Dead Live at War Memorial on 1973-09-26

ai_review.summary: Stunning He’s Gone and atmospheric ’73 set captured in a matrix mix that many love for its spacious bass and audience ambience, though some find the delay‑like sound off.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised as sublime, especially the towering rendition of “He’s Gone” and the lush segues through “Here Comes Sunshine” into the Weather Report>Let It Grow suite, with added brass giving the show a special 1973 flavor. The MTX (matrix) source delivers a more spacious feel—enhanced bass and crowd ambience—but a minority of listeners note a slap‑back‑delay artifact that muddies the mix. Overall the music shines while the recording is generally good but not flawless.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is consistently praised (high rating) while recording quality receives mixed feedback, leading to an overall solid but slightly tempered score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners note improved spatial bass, atmospheric audience bleed and added brass give depth; however one reviewer mentions a slap‑back‑delay effect that sounds artificial.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Long, atmospheric ’73 show praised for its flowing transitions and added brass; the performance feels cohesive and elevated by the audience ambience.
